verses.text: And again, when he bringeth in the first begotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him, who maketh his ministers as a flame of fire.
And of the angels he saith, Angels are ministering spirits.

title: JST, Hebrews 1:6–7. Compare Hebrews 1:6–7 Angels are ministering spirits.
